label: Import Fountain to Pipeline
description: Parses Fountain-format screenplay text and imports the structured data (metadata, characters, locations, sections, elements) into the pipeline's node state. Clears existing state first.

fountainText.description: Fountain-format screenplay text to parse and import

fountainPath.description: Path to a .fountain file to read and import

pipelineId.description: Pipeline ID to save into. Defaults to the current pipeline.

elementCount.description: Total number of elements (dialogue, action, transitions)
